scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:client
scripts.build:host: tsc -b tsconfig.host.json && pnpm --filter dsh-temporary-session exec tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host && node scripts/generate-typert.mjs
scripts.build:client: tsc -b tsconfig.client.json && pnpm --filter dsh-temporary-session exec tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:host && tsc -b tsconfig.client.json --pretty false
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run test
